aquamirae:abyss_blindness.name: Blindness
aquamirae:abyss_blindness.description: Blinding Abyss armor effect. Decreases movement speed.

aquamirae:armor_decrease.name: §cPerforation
aquamirae:armor_decrease.description: Whisper of the Abyss effect. Reduces armor value.

aquamirae:crystallization.name: §cCrystallization
aquamirae:crystallization.description: Blinding Abyss armor effect. You deal 80% less damage and die when the effect ends.

aquamirae:strong_armor.name: Strong Armor
aquamirae:strong_armor.description: Blinding Abyss armor effect. Increases armor value.

aquamirae:swim_speed.name: Speed
aquamirae:swim_speed.description: Terrible armor effect. Increases underwater movement speed.

attributeslib:detonation.name: Flaming Detonation
attributeslib:detonation.description: On expiry, inflicts damage based on remaining fire ticks.

attributeslib:knowledge.name: Ancient Knowledge
attributeslib:knowledge.description: Increases experience gained from kills and blocks.

efn:battle_continuation.name: Battle Continuation
efn:battle_continuation.description: increased movement speed and damage, immune to ranged damage; death occurs after Fighting Spirit ends

efn:gradual_heal.name: Gradual Heal
efn:gradual_heal.description: Restores total health equal to [%5 of max health * potion effect level] over the duration

efn:sin_stun_immunity.name: §o§l§cTrue Stun Immunity
efn:sin_stun_immunity.description: Immune to all types of stun

farmersdelight:comfort.name: Comfort
farmersdelight:comfort.description: Provides natural regeneration, regardless of how hungry you are.

farmersdelight:nourishment.name: Nourishment
farmersdelight:nourishment.description: Prevents hunger loss, except when using saturation to heal damage.

friendsandfoes:glide.name: Glide
friendsandfoes:glide.description: Makes all blocks as slippery as ice.

friendsandfoes:reach.name: Reach
friendsandfoes:reach.description: Increases the range of block interaction.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:aegis.name: Aegis
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:aegis.description: Grants Armor and Spell Resistance to any element

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:erode.name: Erode
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:erode.description: Shred Armor and Spell Resistance to any element

irons_spellbooks:abyssal_shroud.name: Abyssal Shroud
irons_spellbooks:abyssal_shroud.description: Dodge any attack while under its effects, taking no damage

irons_spellbooks:airborne.name: Airborne
irons_spellbooks:airborne.description: You are vulnerable to taking kinetic damage

irons_spellbooks:ascension.name: Ascension
irons_spellbooks:ascension.description: Provides lingering weightlessness from the Ascension spell

irons_spellbooks:blight.name: Blighted
irons_spellbooks:blight.description: Decreases your outgoing damage by 5% per level and incoming healing by 10% per level

irons_spellbooks:charged.name: Charged
irons_spellbooks:charged.description: Increases attack damage by 10% per level, spell power by 5% per level, and speed by 20% per level

irons_spellbooks:chilled.name: Chilled
irons_spellbooks:chilled.description: Decreases movement speed and doubles incoming freeze time

irons_spellbooks:echoing_strikes.name: Echoing Strikes
irons_spellbooks:echoing_strikes.description: While under the effects of the spell, non-magical attack will leave an echo of ender energy behind, shortly thereafter exploding with an echo of the attack's damage.

irons_spellbooks:evasion.name: Evasion
irons_spellbooks:evasion.description: Teleport away from any attack while under its effects, taking no damage

irons_spellbooks:fall_damage_immunity.name: Fall Damage Immunity
irons_spellbooks:fall_damage_immunity.description: Prevented from taking fall damage while under its effects

irons_spellbooks:frostbite.name: Frostbite
irons_spellbooks:frostbite.description: While under the effects of the spell, any fully-frozen creature you kill turn into an Ice Shadow. Ice Shadows shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.

irons_spellbooks:gluttony.name: Gluttony
irons_spellbooks:gluttony.description: Converts food eaten into mana based on its nutrition

irons_spellbooks:guided.name: Guided
irons_spellbooks:guided.description: Nearby projectiles are attracted towards you.

irons_spellbooks:hastened.name: Hastened
irons_spellbooks:hastened.description: Increases movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, mana regeneration, and cast time reduction

irons_spellbooks:heartstop.name: Heartstop
irons_spellbooks:heartstop.description: Become temporarily invulnerable, but take 50% of accumulated damage once it wears off

irons_spellbooks:immolate.name: Immolation
irons_spellbooks:immolate.description: Upon reaching 3 stacks of Immolation, the creature explodes, dealing damage and Immolating nearby creatures

irons_spellbooks:instant_mana.name: Instant Mana
irons_spellbooks:instant_mana.description: Restores 25 mana + 5% of your max mana per level

irons_spellbooks:oakskin.name: Oakskin
irons_spellbooks:oakskin.description: Grants 15% damage reduction, and an additional 5% per level

irons_spellbooks:planar_sight.name: Planar Sight
irons_spellbooks:planar_sight.description: Shift your vision in between planes, gaining the ability to see creatures through solid material

irons_spellbooks:rend.name: Rend
irons_spellbooks:rend.description: Decreases your armor by 5% per level

irons_spellbooks:slowed.name: Slowed
irons_spellbooks:slowed.description: Decreases movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, mana regeneration, and cast time reduction

irons_spellbooks:spider_aspect.name: Aspect of the Spider
irons_spellbooks:spider_aspect.description: Increases your damage dealt against targets with poison by 5% per level

irons_spellbooks:thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
irons_spellbooks:thunderstorm.description: While under the effects of the spell, small bolts of lightning strike nearby creatures every 2 seconds.

irons_spellbooks:true_invisibility.name: True Invisibility
irons_spellbooks:true_invisibility.description: Your body as well as armor and items become invisible while under its effects

irons_spellbooks:vigor.name: Vigor
irons_spellbooks:vigor.description: Gain 1 additional heart of max hp per level

mowziesmobs:eclipsed.name: Eclipse
mowziesmobs:eclipsed.description: Prevents all other status effects while active.

mowziesmobs:frozen.name: Frozen
mowziesmobs:frozen.description: Prevents all actions for a short duration. Fire damage will remove the effect early.

mowziesmobs:geomancy.name: Geomancy
mowziesmobs:geomancy.description: Allows you to command the power of the earth.

mowziesmobs:sunblock.name: Sunblock
mowziesmobs:sunblock.description: A small boost to regeneration and damage resistance.

mowziesmobs:suns_blessing.name: Sun's Blessing
mowziesmobs:suns_blessing.description: Allows you to command the power of the sun.

obscure_api:fury.name: Fury
obscure_api:fury.description: Each level increase the power of class abilities by 10%.

obscure_api:knowledge.name: Knowledge
obscure_api:knowledge.description: Displays hidden information about some items in their tooltips.

obscure_api:rush.name: Rush
obscure_api:rush.description: Each level reduces the cooldown of class abilities by 10%.

supplementaries:flammable.name: Flammable
supplementaries:flammable.description: Increases on fire duration and spreads fire as you walk

supplementaries:overencumbered.name: Overencumbered
supplementaries:overencumbered.description: Prevents sprinting. Further levels reduce jump height hinder walking speed respectively

traveloptics:abyssal_strike.name: Abyssal Strike
traveloptics:abyssal_strike.description: Attacks have a chance to spread the Abyssal Curse effect to nearby entities.

traveloptics:aerial_collapse.name: Aerial Collapse
traveloptics:aerial_collapse.description: Causes the affected entity to fly and crash down, dealing percentage-based damage to their health, ignoring armor.

traveloptics:assassin.name: Assassin
traveloptics:assassin.description: Grants true invisibility, greatly increases movement speed and attack damage. The effect is removed after the first attack.

traveloptics:astral_sense.name: Astral Sense [Entity]
traveloptics:astral_sense.description: Alert the player about incoming projectiles, targeting and approaching entities.

traveloptics:astral_sense_treasure.name: Astral Sense [Treasure]
traveloptics:astral_sense_treasure.description: Helps the player to find chests, traps, and valuable blocks.

traveloptics:azure_frenzy.name: Azure Frenzy
traveloptics:azure_frenzy.description: Grants attack speed to the affected player while the Galenic Polarizer is held in the main hand

traveloptics:blackout.name: Blackout
traveloptics:blackout.description: Affected get their magic suppressed for the entire duration, they can melee attack.

traveloptics:corroded.name: Corroded
traveloptics:corroded.description: Reduces resistance to fire spells and corrodes armor.

traveloptics:flames_reborn.name: Flames Reborn
traveloptics:flames_reborn.description: Ignite a wave of fire, marking your place in time. If you fall, the flames will resurrect you at your marked spot, fully restoring your health

traveloptics:flare_vacuum.name: Flare Vacuum
traveloptics:flare_vacuum.description: Pulls in nearby entities with a fiery vacuum effect before bursting into flame jets.

traveloptics:floodgate.name: Floodgate
traveloptics:floodgate.description: Imposes a damage cap on the caster, ensuring that any incoming damage exceeding the threshold is reduced to the cap. When damage surpasses the threshold, waves surge outward in all directions, dealing damage.

traveloptics:frozen_sight.name: Frozen Sight
traveloptics:frozen_sight.description: Fixes the entity’s vision at the point they were looking when the effect took hold. Also disables certain player abilities.

traveloptics:jet_steam.name: Jet Steam
traveloptics:jet_steam.description: Significantly boosts elytra flight and swimming speed.

traveloptics:lingering_strain.name: Lingering Strain
traveloptics:lingering_strain.description: Splits incoming burst damage into four parts, dealt over 8 seconds instead of instantly.

traveloptics:meteor_storm.name: Meteor Storm
traveloptics:meteor_storm.description: Summons Ignis fireballs to rain down from the sky. If the caster's health falls below 50%, the fireballs transform into soul-fired projectiles.

traveloptics:nullflare_fire.name: Nullflare Fire
traveloptics:nullflare_fire.description: Deals damage-over-time to the affected entity.

traveloptics:nullflare_ice.name: Nullflare Ice
traveloptics:nullflare_ice.description: Slows and chills the affected entity.

traveloptics:phantom_rage.name: Phantom Rage
traveloptics:phantom_rage.description: Increases Attack damage, Spell power, Arrow damage.

traveloptics:replenish.name: Replenish
traveloptics:replenish.description: Adds mana regeneration to the affected entity.

traveloptics:reversal.name: Reversal
traveloptics:reversal.description: Reverses any incoming damage. Additionally, it can copy incoming projectiles.

traveloptics:spectral_blink.name: Spectral Blink
traveloptics:spectral_blink.description: After 3 seconds, teleports the affected entity to the entity they were looking at, passing through any blocks.

traveloptics:spirit_damage_helper.name: Spirit Damage
traveloptics:spirit_damage_helper.description: A helper effect to simulate scaling damage on Dinosaur Spirits.

traveloptics:third_person_switch.name: Force Third Person
traveloptics:third_person_switch.description: Forces the affected player to switch to third person perspective. Switches back to first person when effect ends.

traveloptics:tidal_grasp.name: Tidal Grasp
traveloptics:tidal_grasp.description: Helper effects for Tidal grasp spell.

traveloptics:tidal_grasp_helper.name: Tidal Grasp
traveloptics:tidal_grasp_helper.description: Helper effects for Tidal grasp spell.

traveloptics:tidal_torment.name: Tidal Torment
traveloptics:tidal_torment.description: Causes nearby entities to take area damage when the affected target is struck by the Trident of the Eternal Maelstrom

traveloptics:vigor_siphon.name: Vigor Siphon
traveloptics:vigor_siphon.description: While affected, Damage dealt by the summon heals you, and your damage heals the summon in return. If you die while tethered, the linked summon is sacrificed to restore you with 8hp

traveloptics:void_collapse.name: Void Collapse
traveloptics:void_collapse.description: Lifts affected entities into the air, then slams them down, dealing damage based on the effect’s amplifier

traveloptics:vortex_punch.name: Vortex Uppercut
traveloptics:vortex_punch.description: Helper effect for Vortex Uppercut spell.

traveloptics:wet.name: Wet
traveloptics:wet.description: Reduces resistance to ice and lightning spells.
